summary: Lodja territory (Sankuru) comprises Lodja city, the main town of Sankuru, and the Lodja, Omendjadi and Vanga Kete secteurs. It lies far from the eastern conflict zones and outside the core 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu theatre; insecurity is mainly political unrest in Lodja (Sankuru governorship and electoral disputes), banditry and local land/chieftaincy conflicts rather than territorial armed groups. All locations are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as the main permanent force (FARDC and ANR present in Lodja town). Live web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for Lodja city and low for rural areas.

zones.description: Lodja city (all neighbourhoods) and the contiguous Kibombo agglomeration, Lodja health zone
zones.evidence: Lodja is the largest town of Sankuru and territorial seat, with territorial administration, a PNC commissariat, courts, prison and a FARDC detachment/airfield presence. Insecurity there is episodic (political/electoral unrest, Sankuru provincial power disputes, urban banditry) and is handled by the PNC, with FARDC reinforcement during riots; no armed group is known to hold or administer any quarter. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.

zones.description: Rural villages of Lodja secteur (Lodja, Vanga Kete, Omendjadi, Ototo, Djalo Ndjeka health-zone fringes)
zones.evidence: Villages around Lodja under thin PNC posts, territorial administration and customary chiefs; local insecurity consists of banditry and land/chieftaincy or inter-community disputes, with no organised armed group known to control territory. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.

zones.description: Omendjadi secteur (Omendjadi, Lomela, Tshudi Loto, Lodja health-zone villages), north of Lodja
zones.evidence: Remote forest secteur north of Lodja with thin state presence (PNC posts, chefs de groupement); no armed group is known to hold or tax any locality. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.

zones.description: Vanga Kete secteur (Vanga Kete and Ototo health zones, incl. Ngembe, Koto, Oyokenye), south/south-west of Lodja
zones.evidence: Rural secteur toward the Kasai/Lubefu borders; not part of the Kamuina Nsapu theatre and no armed group known to control any locality. Order is kept by sparse PNC posts and customary chiefs under the territorial administration. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.
